User Story Description: As a student, I want to create an account and authenticate with JWT security, so that my career data and progress remain private and secure.
As a student, I want to set up my student profile with degree, university, graduation year, and skills, so that the AI understands my background.
As a student, I want to upload my PDF/DOCX resume for automated Gemini AI parsing and skill extraction, so that I don't have to manually type my skills.
As a candidate, I want to receive a SWOT analysis of my resume, so that I understand my strengths and skill gaps early on.
As a student, I want to browse a verified catalog of 180+ tech internships, so that I can discover relevant opportunities.
As a system, I want to chunk internship postings into semantic units and generate dense vector embeddings (720 chunks), so that semantic retrieval is fast and accurate.
As a student, I want a Job-Resume Matching Agent to calculate a multi-factor compatibility score with transparent reasoning, so that I understand my fit.
As an evaluator, I want to benchmark matching accuracy across diverse student profiles, so that the matching engine achieves >85% MRR and >80% Top-1 accuracy.
As a student, I want a 5-category Skill Gap Analysis Agent with personalized roadmaps, so that I know exactly what project to build to close my gaps.
As an applicant, I want to generate ATS-optimized STAR bullet points and targeted cover letters with strict anti-hallucination guardrails, so that my applications stand out.
As a candidate, I want an AI Mock Interview Coach with speech-to-text and 3D scoring (Technical, Communication, Relevance), so that I can practice interview questions.
As a student, I want a Conversational Career Assistant orchestrator that retains multi-turn context and compares opportunities, so that I receive strategic guidance.
